title: Carrier Battle Group
summary: Take a shift on a nine-ship carrier group and time three recoveries. In the ocean sandbox, follow a jet from the tower into the sky and switch between sunset, storm, and night.
summaryZhTW: 在九艘艦艇組成的航艦編隊值班，掌握三次飛機回收的時機。進入海洋沙盒，從塔台目送戰機起飛，切換跟拍視角，在夕陽、風暴與夜色中觀察艦隊。
coverAlt: A carrier with jets parked on deck sails toward the viewer at dawn, with escorts on the horizon.
controls: Drag to orbit the fleet. Choose Flight Deck Watch to time launch and recovery signals, or Ocean Sandbox to use the camera and weather controls.
limitations: Requires WebGL. The ocean sandbox loads external resources and needs an internet connection.

approval.note: Creator requested deployment of both modules and a Carrier Battle Group card in Possibility Games.
